result:
All 8 tests pass. Here's a summary of the changes made:

- **`src/billing/subscription.js`** — `makeSubscription` accepts `currency` and includes it on the returned object, defaulting to `"USD"`.
- **`src/billing/subscribe.js`** — `subscribe` accepts optional `currency`, rejects anything not matching `/^[A-Z]{3}$/` with `invalid_currency`, and passes it through to `makeSubscription`.
- **`src/billing/invoice.js`** — `generateInvoice` copies `sub.currency` onto the invoice object.
- **`test/billing.test.js`** — new test creates a user, subscribes with `currency: 'EUR'`, generates an invoice, and asserts `inv.currency === 'EUR'`.
